description: Berkhoff et al. (1982) elliptic shoal on a 1:50 slope rotated by 20 deg, regular waves T = 1 s, H = 4.64 cm (3D refraction, diffraction, nonlinear focusing behind the shoal) with NHFLOW. Wave heights H/H0 along sections 1-5 (across the tank at x = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 m behind the shoal centre) and 6-8 (along the tank at y = -2, 0, 2 m) against the measurements. Bathymetry from geo.dat written by tools/berkhoff_geo.py (Basilisk shoal.c formula, minimum depth 0.07 m).

reference.citation: Berkhoff, J.C.W., Booy, N. & Radder, A.C. (1982) Verification computations with linear wave propagation models. Coastal Engineering 6, 255-279. Sections 1-8 (amplitudes) from the FUNWAVE-TVD benchmark car_berkhoff_2d, see refdata/PROVENANCE_git_sources.md

check.note: sections 1-8 from FUNWAVE-TVD (amplitudes, H/H0 = a/23.2 mm); y in the FUNWAVE frame, which matches the Basilisk shoal.c frame used for the bathymetry (checked against the Basilisk copy of section 5: rms difference 0.03)
